rationale: The agent executed multiple order-changing writes (address update, item exchange, and cancellation) without first confirming with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Although tool calls suggest attempts to authenticate (find_user_id_by_email) and to act on the specified orders (get_order_details), there is no explicit confirmation of ownership or pre-action confirmation. The final message only reports the cancellation and omits outcomes for the address change and exchange, so it does not clearly present all requested changes. It also states a refund timeline not evidenced by tool outputs. Therefore, the interaction fails the pass bar.
